ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left is a square cut from grid paper, which can be regarded as 7×7 unit squares; in it there is a white missing region extending from the upper middle toward the lower right, indicating the part that was later cut away again. On the right there are four candidate polyominoes, numbered 1, 2, 3, 4, each composed of several unit squares. Reasoning: According to the method, first regard the left side as a complete 7×7 grid, and then mark only the white missing unit squares. The missing region is stair-shaped and can be covered by two candidate figures in total. Encode the four candidate figures according to the grid directions and try translating them into the missing region: the long stair shape of figure 2 exactly covers the lower part and lower-right part of the gap; after covering, the remaining upper gap shape matches the unit-square arrangement of figure 3. Figures 2 and 3 together have no overlap and do not extend beyond the missing region. Other combinations would leave empty squares or cover squares that were originally kept. Therefore the figures cut away are figure 2 and figure 3.

raw_record.question_text: The square was cut out from a page in a squared exercise book. Then two figures in the picture were cut out from the square. Which ones?

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: the left side shows a squared-book square with some unit grid cells missing; the right side shows four candidate polyomino figures labeled 1, 2, 3, and 4. Treat the left square as a full rectangular grid and mark every unit cell that is absent from the remaining square. Then encode each candidate figure by its unit-square pattern. Compare pairs of candidate patterns by translating them into the missing region, allowing the same grid alignment used in the picture. The correct pair must exactly cover all missing unit cells with no overlap and no extra cells. Carrying out this exact-cover check identifies figures 2 and 3.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：左侧是一块从方格纸上剪下的正方形，可看作 7×7 的单位方格；其中有一个从上部中间向右下方延伸的白色缺失区域，表示后来又被剪掉的部分。右侧有四个候选多连方形，编号为 1、2、3、4，每个都由若干单位方格组成。推理：按方法把左侧先当作完整的 7×7 方格，然后只标出白色缺失的单位格。缺失区域呈阶梯状，共可由两个候选图形覆盖。将四个候选图形按方格方向编码并尝试平移到缺失区域中：图形 2 的长阶梯形状正好覆盖缺口的下部和右下部分；覆盖后剩下的上部缺口形状与图形 3 的单位方格排列吻合。图形 2 和图形 3 合在一起没有重叠，也没有超出缺失区域。其他组合会留下空格或覆盖到原本保留的方格。因此被剪掉的是图形 2 和图形 3。

method.CoT_qualify_0: 推理顺序符合“先描述图像，再推理”，最终答案也与标准答案一致。图像描述中的 7×7 方格、左侧缺失区域、右侧四个编号候选图形等主要视觉信息与图片相符。方法上也基本遵循了把缺失区域与候选多连方形做平移匹配、检查无重叠无多余格的思路。不过，候选推理没有明确列出缺失单元格坐标，也没有实际给出各候选图形的编码或逐一组合排除过程；“图形2覆盖下部和右下部分、剩余上部与图形3吻合”属于较概括的断言。若要更严谨，应补充缺失格的行列坐标，以及图形2、图形3平移后的具体覆盖格子，从而直接展示 exact-cover 检查。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This uses a direct grid-complement/exact-cover route: reconstruct the missing cells of the original square and test candidate pairs as polyomino covers, rather than relying on visual resemblance alone.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the large cut square, its grid-cell structure, the missing-cell region, and the four labeled candidate polyomino shapes from the image.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the statement that exactly two of the displayed figures were cut out from the square, so the answer must be a pair of labels.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the polyomino matching rule: cutting figures from a squared grid removes whole unit cells, so the union of the two selected shapes must equal the complement of the remaining grid square.
